prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: production raster flowchart image for a Korean developer portfolio project page.
Create a polished, highly legible Korean survey authorization flowchart on a plain white background. Portrait composition, approximately 3:4 aspect ratio. Flat, precise, vector-like rendering, restrained professional styling. This is a functional decision diagram, not an illustration or mockup.

Layout: one vertical main path in the left/center area, with short horizontal branches to terminal outcomes on the right. Three large diamond decision nodes, evenly spaced. Start and terminal nodes use modest rounded rectangles. Straight arrowed connectors, no crossing lines. Branch labels sit next to their own connectors and do not overlap shapes. Keep margins compact and text very large, bold or medium Korean sans serif similar to Pretendard/Noto Sans KR, legible when the image is displayed at 360 CSS pixels wide. Use intentional two-line text inside diamonds and outcomes. No heading, caption, legend, numbering, or explanatory paragraphs inside the image; those are provided by the webpage.

Exact content and topology:
Start at top: "설문 접근 요청".
Arrow down to diamond 1, text on two lines: "설문" / "대상인가요?"
Diamond 1 RIGHT branch labeled "아니요" -> terminal "접근 차단".
Diamond 1 DOWN branch labeled "예" -> diamond 2, text on two lines: "제출을" / "완료했나요?"
Diamond 2 RIGHT branch labeled "예" -> terminal with two lines "기존 결과" / "조회".
Diamond 2 DOWN branch labeled "아니요" -> diamond 3, text on three lines: "설문이" / "일시정지" / "상태인가요?"
Diamond 3 RIGHT branch labeled "예" -> terminal with two lines "수정과 제출 제한" / "기존 답변 보존".
Diamond 3 DOWN branch labeled "아니요" -> terminal with two lines "해당 운영 상태의" / "권한 정책 적용".

Logic is essential: being outside the survey target group always blocks access. A target user who already submitted goes directly to existing results, bypassing the paused-state decision. Only non-submitted target users reach the paused-state decision. Never label the final no branch as unconditional permission to edit or submit.

Palette matching the site: white canvas; normal node fill #f5f5f5; result-view node fill #dbe2ef; text #112d4e; connector arrows neutral medium gray; borders neutral gray similar to #d9d9d9, with a clearly visible outline around every diamond and rectangle. Red text can be used only for "접근 차단" and "수정과 제출 제한". No colored borders. No gradients, shadows, 3D effects, icons, decorations, watermark, logo, English text, or middle-dot punctuation. No outer canvas border, because the webpage adds that border. Render Korean text exactly as specified and all six yes/no labels correctly.
